title: Samsung Galaxy F14 5G - 6GB RAM, 128GB Storage
description: Samsung Galaxy F14 5G features a 6.7-inch PLS TFT display, 50 MP main camera, MediaTek Dimensity 700 processor and 5000 mAh battery with 25W fast charging.

reviews.author: Arjun D.
reviews.title: Samsung quality at this price
reviews.body: Display is bright and colour accurate. One UI is smooth and lag-free.

reviews.author: Meera V.
reviews.title: Good 5G phone
reviews.body: Battery lasts a full day of mixed use. Camera clicks good photos in daylight.

reviews.author: Kartik N.
reviews.title: Average performance
reviews.body: Heats up a bit during gaming. Software updates promised but slow to roll out.
